scientific_integrity: All claims rest on the finite phase-language transfer and its complete cyclic-component decomposition; independently written original-time history and direct state-update checks are included. No statement is made about all eventual periods.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for period three on 2-by-n periodic Moore torus with eight offsets counted with multiplicity and n>=3. A published general graph method exists. Full historical 1996 active essay inaccessible; independent priority and external correctness audit not performed.
